description: Two hooks. SessionStart injects the derived deficit table once per context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact) with an opener conditioned on the source — scripts/route-session.mjs. UserPromptSubmit carries the per-prompt firing conditions for /route — scripts/route-prompt.mjs. Only `description` and `hooks` go in this file: Codex rejects any other top-level key and then registers none of these hooks.
